description:
It was a dark and stormy night, and nobody could've guessed what was about to happen. Richard was just an average guy walking home through the woods, but he had no idea what awaited him.

Suddenly, he heard a sound coming from the trees that made his heart stop: the sound of a woman screaming. He raced to find the source of the sound, his heart pounding with dread. He soon found the source: a woman tied up in a clearing. He cut her free, but as he did, he noticed a creature lurking in the shadow
